description: Matched encoder study separating Celeste image-domain adaptation, ordered future-latent prediction, and learned pre-pooling frame-pair features.

scientific_scope.name: Photon-inspired JEPA-style dynamics pretraining
scientific_scope.reason: Photon-1 publicly specifies next-token prediction over discrete FSQ frame latents and only a high-level paired differential encoder; the continuous EMA target, native-rate horizons, and pair-stem topology here are MADELEINE adaptations.

embargo.rule: forbidden for discovery, pretraining, supervised fitting, inference, thresholding, calibration, selection, or diagnostics
other_exclusions: own-v3 val-A is probe validation only and is excluded from all self-supervised pretraining
B1 is excluded until after the y4n decision is committed
the whole y4nQHqYSObI video is excluded from self-supervised pretraining even without labels

phase_0_probe.pruning_rule: Apply the global horizon gate in dynamics_offset_probe_v1.json. Select the shortest passing candidate; add a longer passing candidate only if it detects at least two additional estimable tasks or improves macro conditioned AP-skill lift by at least 0.02 with paired lower confidence bound above zero. No unregistered horizon may be introduced. If none passes, stop before Arms C and D.

wild_provisional.selection_caveat: membership was selected using decoded-key activity, although no decoded action value is consumed by pretraining

pretraining_population.source_sampling: proportional to the validated eligible pair count in each source, with no source oversampling; exact source probabilities are frozen in the pretraining-index receipt before optimizer step one

static_change_sampling.threshold: training-population median endpoint luma absolute difference, frozen in the data-index receipt

A.name: imagenet_resnet18
A.retrain_policy: reuse only after exact feature/config/checkpoint hashes validate; do not rerun merely to rename the arm

B.name: celeste_same_frame_self_distillation
B.online_input: one masked frame under view one
B.target_input: the same frame under view two
B.matched_sampling: uses the exact same (session,t,h,masked-pixel-motion-stratum) population, positive horizon tokens, tail truncation, and per-horizon quotas as C; h affects sampling and predictor conditioning but not B's same-frame target

C.name: celeste_future_latent
C.horizon_conditioning: shared predictor plus learned horizon embedding

D.name: celeste_future_latent_ordered_pair
D.pair_stem: nine-channel [previous,current,signed current-minus-previous] ResNet-18 input convolution; ImageNet current-frame slice copied and all added slices zero-initialized
D.first_contiguous_frame: previous equals current, producing an explicit zero difference
D.purpose: learn state and signed motion before spatial pooling

initialization.policy: the online encoder loads these exact bytes and the target encoder is then an exact copy

shared_ssl_recipe.target_encoder: stop-gradient exponential-moving-average copy of online encoder
shared_ssl_recipe.loss: mean per-example L1 between l2-normalized prediction and stop-gradient target latent
collapse_controls: mean pairwise cosine and nearest-neighbor diversity
shared_ssl_recipe.augmentation: two independently sampled views; every spatial/color transform is constant over all frames within one ordered tuple; no horizontal/vertical flip
shared_ssl_recipe.compute_matching: B, C, and D use identical optimizer steps, optimizer, source sampler, batch pair count, online/target encoder-view count, augmentation family, EMA schedule, and checkpoint cadence
shared_ssl_recipe.horizon_batching: B, C, and D draw the same preregistered positive horizon tokens with equal per-step quotas across surviving horizons; B uses each h only as a matched nuisance token and to reproduce C's anchor/motion-stratum population
shared_ssl_recipe.checkpoint_selection: final weights only; no downstream or evaluation metric selects an SSL checkpoint
shared_ssl_recipe.throughput_gate: 100 real optimizer steps; do not launch full pretraining if projected runtime exceeds the separately approved compute budget

production_blockers: streaming RGB cache and compact shared tuple index
mixed-precision prefetched trainer with atomic resume state
numeric collapse gates on a fixed stratified diagnostic panel
validated final-EMA feature exporter with gap-safe D inference
resolved numeric run budget and separately approved storage/GPU shape

feature_export.encoder_state: final EMA target encoder for B, C, and D; the online encoder is never an alternative export candidate
feature_export.latent_value: raw unnormalized 512-D global-average-pooled encoder output; L2 normalization is used only inside the SSL loss
feature_export.run_boundaries: never borrow a previous frame across a session, shard discontinuity, or engine-frame gap
feature_export.forbidden_format_label: resnet18_imagenet_avgpool_float16_v1 for B, C, or D

downstream_contract.architecture: unchanged 25.7M centered GRU over frozen 512-D features with post-pool feature deltas
downstream_contract.threshold_policy: fixed 0.5 for headline state and derived transition decisions; oracle thresholds diagnostic only
downstream_contract.head_policy: do not add, remove, or retune state/onset/release heads in this encoder study

evaluation.primary_surface: mapped y4n later-eight streams on identical support
primary_metrics: segment-bounded combined onset/release collar-0 F1 at fixed 0.5
segment-bounded combined onset/release plus-or-minus-2-frame F1 at fixed 0.5
secondary_metrics: macro and per-key average precision with prevalence
micro and seven-key joint key-state accuracy
evaluation.seed_zero_promotion_rule: Relative to the immediately matched control (C versus B; D versus C), plus-or-minus-2 event F1 must improve by at least 0.010 absolute, collar-0 F1 may not fall by more than 0.002, and macro AP may not fall by more than 0.005.
evaluation.replication: Only a promoted arm receives seeds 1 and 2. A claimed improvement requires the primary delta to have the same sign in at least two of three seeds and a positive three-seed mean.
evaluation.multiplicity: record every arm and seed consulted; do not turn a sensitivity result into a matched headline
evaluation.post_decision: B1 may be scored fixed-only only after the y4n decision and all candidate checkpoint hashes are committed
